semantics.goal: Issue a task-directed body target within the fixed-foot support region, stabilize the base and tool, then execute recovery and insertion at the docking fixture.
excludes: renaming the existing fixed-duration body drift
allowing only one method to command the body target
using unreachable initial states to manufacture failures

evidence: actual base pose reaches the declared target region
all feet remain in the declared support
base and tcp speed below frozen limits
body tilt, height, support, and joint margins remain valid for the stability dwell
actual retreat or unloading after stabilization
terminal pose, wrench, support, and dwell conditions

public: issued body and arm request history

success: the base reaches the task-directed target within fixed-foot support
the predock stability dwell completes before contact recovery
docking is held within pose, force, support, body, and joint limits
violations: foot slip, relocation, or undeclared contact loss
anti_bypass: require actual base displacement toward the task-directed target
reject docking before the predock stability event
derive fixed-foot support from physical contact traces
use a preregistered jointly reachable initial-state set for all methods

requirements: source performs task-directed body reposition rather than a timed drift
source completes reposition, predock stabilization, recovery, insertion, and hold in order
qualification demonstrates joint arm-body feasibility without foot relocation
source actor, reachable-state roster, and configuration digests are frozen before target development
source_qualification.evidence_resolution: results/quadruped/mobile_keyed_insertion_recovery/validation/reposition_then_dock/report.json; every control tick, public target and issued body request, physical foot contacts and slip, WBC residual, wrench, ordered recovery, insertion, and hold evidence; four compressed episodes independently reevaluated

historical_evidence_policy: The existing timed body-intent task remains stance-insertion evidence only; no historical mobile result is relabeled as task-directed reposition-then-dock.
